name: image_memory
description: An image metadata management tool that stores, updates, retrieves, and clears persistent or temporary visual metadata and analysis notes. Use whenever image analysis results or visual references need to be remembered across conversation turns. Use this to maintain long-term visual memory and avoid redundant image reprocessing.

image_id.description: ID of the image. Auto-generated if not provided on store.

vision_text.description: Vision analysis text for the image.

is_persistent.description: Whether image is persistent (sent every request). Default true.
